messages.subject: Deducer Error: could not find function ".javaGD.set.class.path"
parts:
Hallo all,

I have problem starting Deducer without JGR. Whan I start Deducer and JGR everything is fine (I dont use JGR as there is no Serbian Latin characters in Java window), but when I start Deducer in plain R it opens and builds menus. However, if I try to open a file, or do analysis I got the following error

 

Error: could not find function ".javaGD.set.class.path"

 

Starting JavaGD(), opens java window and dev.off() closes it as it should

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Deducer Error: could not find function ".javaGD.set.class.path"
parts:
I was able to reproduce the error; however, on my system, the error is
emitted once upon loading Deducer but everything works as expected. Is
this the same on your machine?

That function was recently hidden inside the JavaGD namespace, so it
was not found when Deducer was looking for it. I've changed it to look
in the appropriate space. Regardless, Deducer outside of the JGR
console should be considered a non-standard use-at-your-own-risk kind
of thing.


Best,
Ian
